title: North Korea says defence research institutes tested major weapon system
paragraphs: North Korea says defence research institutes tested major weapon system
The test was intended to “assess adaptation to combat and power of a cluster-bomb warhead to be tipped on tactical ballistic missiles”, state media KCNA said on Saturday (Oct 31).
SEOUL: North Korea’s state media KCNA reported on Saturday (Oct 31) that the country’s defence science research institutes tested a major weapon system.
